priors.description: AIS Nav density (Kole 2008): 0.25-0.5 S/cm^2 typical RGC AIS. Conservative sigma of 0.125 covers the published range.
AIS Nav density (Werginz 2024): 1.3 S/cm^2 modeled value matching RGC AIS spike threshold. Sigma 0.3 (~25 percent).
Distal dendritic Nav1.6 density (Oesch 2005): 0.05 S/cm^2 supports DSGC dendritic spikes. Sigma 0.02 (~40 percent).
Distal NaP density (Stuart 1999, Goldfinger 2000): 0.0005 S/cm^2. Sigma 0.0002.
Dendritic NMDA per-synapse conductance (Sivyer 2013): ~0.1 nS = 1e-4 uS. Sigma 5e-5.

NMDA Mg-block voff offset (Branco-Hausser 2010): published Mg-block midpoint at ~-25 mV; the t0080 Exp2NMDA implementation uses VOFF as a deviation from the canonical -25 mV midpoint, so 0 mV = published. Sigma 5 mV captures published variability.
GABA spatial baseline (de Rosenroll 2026): rho0=1.0 in the canonical linear gradient model. Sigma 0.5.
GABA spatial decay length (de Rosenroll 2026): ~80 um. Sigma 30.

AIS-to-soma Nav ratio (Werginz 2024): 17.3x. Computed as centroid[NAV16_AIS_GBAR] / centroid[NAV16_SOMA_GBAR]. The t0080 constraint enforces ratio >= 5, so we are checking how close it is to the 17.3x published target.
